summary: New hire processes an equipment invoice by selecting it, assigning the correct cost center, and sending for approval.

reason.text: Start by opening the invoice that needs to be processed

steps.title: Code cost center
steps.decision: Assign capex 0400 for equipment over EUR 5,000

reason.text: Physical equipment over EUR 5,000 must be capitalised using capex cost center 0400
reason.quote: Anything above five thousand euros that is physical equipment goes to capex, never opex

guardrails.rule: Equipment invoices over EUR 5,000 must be coded to capex 0400, not opex 4711
guardrails.quote: Anything above five thousand euros that is physical equipment goes to capex, never opex

steps.title: Send for approval
steps.decision: Send to approval queue once cost center is correct

reason.text: Once the cost center is correctly assigned, the invoice must be routed for approval

teachback_rounds.text: So to summarise: you start by opening the equipment invoice, then you assign capex 0400 for anything over EUR 5,000, and finally you send it for approval.
